lineage.prior: AT inverse source-blind 0/48 vs 48/48 evaluator-only correct inverse; 12bit alternate 2413 41/48 FP6 FN1 fails long-positive preservation. No AT DEV used. All negatives retained.

source.constructor: unchanged qualified original AO birth, rebinding only fresh operator IDs and seeds; no DEV constructors in this gate

Yggdrasil.hypothesis: A source-blind sparse parity inverse learned robustly from noisy public supports can outperform prior failed affine and nearest controls on previously unseen TRAIN-SCREEN tasks without operator names. It must count its additional task-specific model storage.
Yggdrasil.learner: For every input bit independently learn the lowest-error parity of 1, 2 or 3 output bits with optional complement from only 20 public FIT supports; tie-break lexicographically, deterministic. Use CHECK supports only for abstention calibration. No target label, source identity, inverse, or per-source operator catalog reaches fitting.
Yggdrasil.eligibility: On held-out fresh TRAIN-SCREEN (12 seed IDs per vector, 24 paired cases), FP0, paired positive > strongest source-blind control and >=1; original 7 active/9 retained; extra transient task coefficients and runtime explicitly measured. TRAIN-FIT used for candidate selection only. No DEV this gate.

Wingless.hypothesis: Graph-conditioned choice of one packed representation based only on public branch density may suppress spurious causal positives without sacrificing original gamma0 long positives. Only one encoding and one 12bit state/node are ever retained during a forward pass.
Wingless.policy: For a graph, choose one alternate checksum when the public edge-to-role count exceeds a frozen threshold; otherwise original; no model sees source operator, oracle, source labels, or outcomes during inference. Selected policy fitted exclusively on TRAIN-FIT paired labels, then evaluated once on disjoint TRAIN-SCREEN.
Wingless.admission: On untouched TRAIN-SCREEN: strict FP reduction versus original gamma0, same-or-better correct paired count, preserve every original baseline-accepted long (13-15) positive individually, no capacity growth. Training-FIT results may select one candidate but cannot decide SCREEN outcome.
Wingless.source_normalization: Evaluator-only same correct normalization to original graph for all arms; not proof of an end-to-end learned operator.

split: TRAIN-FIT seed index [0,11] and TRAIN-SCREEN seed index [12,23] separately for each two vectors, 24 paired cases each lane per subset. Both subsets frozen and candidates defined before implementation. Never tune based on SCREEN or historical DEV.
